scope: all company_group nodes from the dated registry; no project/reference nodes; analytical aggregation of independent groups, not statutory control consolidation
notes: Empty transaction ledgers mean unavailable, never zero actual cash or sales.
Reported corporate investments remain in the financing disclosure schedule until execution, period and bilateral reconciliation are reviewed.
Do not insert contract notional, backlog, credit limits, GW capacity or warrants into cash/sales ledgers.
Parent-company context uses each issuer's latest available TTM, labeled by exact dates; it is not summed across fiscal calendars.
No identical-calendar group estimate is inferred from mismatched TTM figures.
